'''Alyn Rae''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="NEGTAS" /> [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] entrepreneur who<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|73|Rae, Alyn}}</ref> by around [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEGTAS Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' dates itself to shortly after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. Thus, Alyn Rae's creation of the [[cone sock]] must take place by around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> had developed the [[cone sock]], a chemical-based [[Clothing/Legends|garment]] worn on a Gotal's sensitivity head [[cones]] to protect them from disorientating and painful electromagnetic emissions produced by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other technology. While designing cone socks, Rae worked with several [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who were not native to the Gotal [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]], as they were adept at using the equipment required to design and construct the garment. Cone socks were expensive and initially only worn by wealthy Gotals, but their practicality saw them grow in popularity<ref name="NEGTAS" /> and become favored in energy-rich environments<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|73|Rae, Alyn}}</ref> by many Gotals throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="NEGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alyn Rae was first mentioned in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]].<ref name="NEGTAS" />
